description: Chinese corporate income tax depreciation: minimum useful lives (buildings 20, machinery 10, tools and furniture 5, other vehicles 4, electronics 3 years; Implementation Regulations art. 60), straight-line from the month after first use with a reasonable residual value (art. 59); one-off deduction for new equipment up to 5 million CNY bought 2024-2027 (MOF/STA 2023 No. 37); accelerated depreciation with lives >= 60% of the minimum, double-declining or sum-of-years (art. 98). Mainland China, as of 2026-11-21 (laws and State Taxation Administration announcements in the official regulations database). General information and estimates only; no individual tax consulting, agency or filing. The 2027 filing calendar is not yet published.
